questions.question: When does the CNOT gate flip the target qubit?
questions.explanation: CNOT flips the target only when the control qubit is in state |1⟩.

questions.question: What state does H(q0)→CNOT(q0,q1) create from |00⟩?
questions.explanation: H puts q0 in superposition, then CNOT correlates q1 with q0, creating the entangled Bell state |Φ+⟩.

questions.question: What do the Bloch spheres show for an entangled Bell state?
questions.explanation: In an entangled state, each qubit individually is maximally mixed — its Bloch vector is at the origin. The quantum information is in the correlations between qubits, not in either qubit alone.
